organizationSetupBody: If your account does not have an active workspace yet, finish the assignment in the backend and then refresh access here.
workspaceSelectBody: Choose the workspace you want to operate in, accept an invitation, or create a new one.
workspaceSelectEmptyBody: Create your first workspace to unlock the Humoo shell.
workspaceCreateBody: Use the real backend fields only. Creating the workspace also provisions your owner membership.
workspaceDefaultLocaleHint: This default is stored in the workspace and can differ from your user profile.
workspaceAccessPendingBody: This account authenticated correctly, but it still has no active workspace assigned in the API. Assign a workspace membership in Laravel or seeders, then refresh.
routing.unauthorized: You need to sign in to continue.
routing.workspaceRequired: You need an active workspace to continue.
routing.notFound.title: This route does not exist
routing.notFound.description: The page you opened is unavailable or has moved. Return to a safe route to continue.
chatSubtitle: A provisional shell for chat, operations, and kitchen visibility.
chatWelcomeBody: This provisional screen validates the private shell, organization context, and the future AI surface.
chatQuickActionPrep: Ask what needs prep this week.
chatQuickActionInventory: Review missing ingredients once the API is connected.
chatQuickActionModules: Open the future calendar and operations modules.
chatAssistantSample: I can turn your conversation into prep, event, and operational follow-up once the contracts are connected.
chatUserSample: Show me what the kitchen should prep first for this week.
chatAssistantErrorSample: I could not finish loading the next answer yet.
chatStreamingSampleDescription: The assistant is gathering context and preparing the next response.
chatClarificationTitle: Which day should I use for the prep plan?
chatClarificationDescription: I found more than one possible interpretation. Pick one to continue.
chatClarificationOptionTomorrowDescripti: Recommended if you want the next kitchen shift.
chatOperationalPreviewAction: Humoo wants to update the guest count before the next service.
chatOperationalPreviewImpact: This change will increase prep volume for the dinner shift.
chatOperationalConfirmationDescription: This will update the working event details for the team.
chatOperationalResultDescription: The event now reflects the approved guest count.
chatOperationalRecoveryDescription: Humoo could not apply the update because the event was modified by someone else.
chatOperationalRecoverySafeDetail: Reload the latest event version or review the updated changes before trying again.
operationsSubtitle: Events are now connected to the Laravel API. Create and review the first real records here.
calendarSubtitle: Review the shared operational timeline before wiring live event and staffing data.
settingsSubtitle: Theme, language, runtime, sessions, and workspace access live here.
profileSubtitle: Review your identity, locale, and account defaults.
eventsCreateBody: This form posts directly to `/api/v1/events` using the active workspace membership.
eventsListBody: Loaded from the protected events endpoint for the current workspace.
eventsEmpty: No events exist for this workspace yet.
eventsApiRequired: This module requires a real API session. Local fallback mode cannot load protected event data.
eventsCreatePermissionMissing: This account can view the workspace shell, but it does not currently expose the `events.create` permission for event creation.
profileSubtitleLocal: Basic profile persistence is wired through the local auth adapter.
profileSubtitleApi: Profile editing is visible, but backend persistence is still pending.
profileSyncPending: Profile updates are not exposed by the API yet. This form will stay read-only until that endpoint exists.
sessionsBody: Review device sessions and manually revoke any access token you no longer trust.
membersAdminBody: Invite teammates, review pending invitations, and adjust member roles and status from the live API.
membersAdminNoPermission: This account does not expose member administration permissions for the current workspace.
membersAdminActionError: Unable to complete the workspace administration action.
membersEmpty: No members found for this workspace.
workspaceSettingsError: Unable to update the workspace settings.
